components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary actionable call to action with Electric Indigo fill and hover lift.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background-color: #6366f1; color: #ffffff; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: #4f46e5; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Subtle neutral button for secondary workflows and cancellations.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background-color: #f1f5f9; color: #475569; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background-color: #e2e8f0; color: #0f172a; }

components.name: Safe Status Badge
components.description: Soft tinted pill with green dot indicator signaling safe daily spending rate.
components.css: .ds-badge-safe { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background-color: #ecfdf5; color: #10b981; border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2); font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-badge-dot-safe { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background-color: #10b981; }

components.name: Quick Add Preset Chip
components.description: One-tap preset nominal chip for rapid budgeting entries on mobile.
components.css: .ds-preset-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 9999px; background-color: #f1f5f9; color: #0f172a; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s ease; } .ds-preset-chip:hover { background-color: #eef2ff; border-color: #6366f1; color: #4648d4; } .ds-preset-chip:active { transform: scale(0.95); }

narrative.overview: SakuMahasiswa is built around the feeling of opening a crisp, well-organized physical notebook on a clear morning. Instead of confronting students with spreadsheet clutter or dread-inducing debt trackers, it delivers instant financial calmness: an airy slate-and-indigo canvas that immediately answers the one question an Indonesian college student or perantau asks every day: Berapa yang aman saya belanjakan hari ini? The system rejects dark, overbearing fintech austerity and noisy gamification gimmicks.
keyCharacteristics: Crisp, airy daylight atmosphere with high glanceability on outdoor mobile screens.
Dominant hero card hierarchy centered on tabular daily figures.
Gentle, anxiety-free semantic signaling through soft-tinted surfaces.
Mobile-first ergonomic touch zones (minimum 44px) built for rapid, one-handed inputs.

rules.name: The Soft-Shield Rule
rules.body: Semantic status alerts never use screaming saturated full-flood backgrounds. They must always use 10% soft-tint backgrounds (bg-semantic-*-soft) paired with crisp border accents and a saturated dot indicator, eliminating financial panic while maintaining clear hierarchy.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: The primary electric indigo accent is reserved for actionable triggers (CTAs, FAB, active navigation). It occupies <=10% of any given viewport surface to prevent visual fatigue.

rules.name: The Tabular Precision Rule
rules.body: Every currency figure and numerical balance must use .tabular-nums so columns and cards align with mathematical stability without horizontal jitter during live updates.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces rest flush against the tonal background bordered by subtle 1px outlines. Heavy drop shadows are banned; elevation increases only when an element hovers, expands, or hovers over a modal scrim.

dos: Do anchor the Safe to Spend hero figure as the visual focal point of the dashboard.
Do wrap every monetary value in .tabular-nums with explicit Indonesian Rupiah formatting (Rp).
Do maintain a minimum 44px touch target on all clickable mobile elements and bottom navigation links.
Do use soft tinted pill backgrounds (bg-semantic-*-soft) for pace status rather than heavy solid warnings.
Do keep quick-add input flows achievable within 2 taps.
donts: Don't use alarmist, high-saturation pure red full-bleed card backgrounds that induce budgeting panic.
Don't hide remaining cycle days or allowance start dates behind nested submenus.
Don't use non-standard decorative fonts; preserve crisp legibility via Inter with proper tabular numerics.
Don't introduce heavy, dark drop shadows that break the clean daylight ledger aesthetic.
